name: Zwicker
description: Zwicker (Zwickern) is a German fishing card game from Schleswig-Holstein. 52 cards + Jokers. Capture table cards by matching rank or summing values. 'Zwick' bonus for clearing entire table. Builds allowed (add/subtract to create target values). K=14, Q=13, J=12, A=11/1. More entertaining than Casino.

history.origins: Zwicker (Zwickern) is a North German fishing game from Schleswig-Holstein, related to Casino and Scopa. First recorded in print in 1930 in Robert Hülsemann's Das Buch der Spiele; originally played with a 52-card pack, now commonly with 3, 4, or 6 jokers. Popular in Dithmarschen, North Frisia, and Eiderstedt; 58-card Zwicker packs were sold from the 1950s by ASS and Nürnberger Spielkarten.
timeline: 20th century: North German fishing game from Schleswig-Holstein; Zwicker cards sold from 1950s (ASS, Nürnberger Spielkarten).

setup.deck: 52 cards + 0-6 Jokers. K=14, Q=13, J=12, A=11 or 1.
setup.dealing: Cards dealt in stages. Table layout created.

rules.objective: Capture cards from the table by matching rank or summing values; score points for valuable cards (jokers, ten of diamonds, aces), for majority of cards, and for each Zwick (clearing the table). The team with the higher total after the hand wins.
rules.gameplay: Play card to capture by rank match or value sum. Build on table cards (add/subtract to target). 'Zwick' = clearing entire table (bonus). Can't capture = trail (add card to table). Last capturer gets remaining cards.
keyRules: Rank match or value sum capture

scoring.description: Points for most cards, specific captures. Zwick bonuses.
scoring.winCondition: Capture most cards and valuable cards.
